purpose: Teach: 健二/シェル/獣医/さようなら/ドック/アルプス/土俵/囲碁

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい社員の健二さん、本気で、頼もしい人ね、メイちゃん、葵で、感心、しちゃう、本気で、絶対、本当に、嬉しい、感謝。
lines.en: Aoi, the new staff member Kenji is really dependable. I'm genuinely impressed with him.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine admiration without overselling. Soft lift on 'dependable.' Quick, easy delivery—the confidence of speaking about someone you respect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。シェル型の、お洒落な、お皿、葵で、本気で、揃えたわよ、お客様、本気で、好評、メイちゃん、絶対、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yeah. Those new shell-pattern plates we stocked—customers have been really into them.
lines.style: Pleased and matter-of-fact. Light brightness on the accomplishment without fishing for praise. Easy rhythm, like she's sharing good news over a shared task.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うちの愛犬、最近、獣医さんに、本気で、診てもらってるのよ、葵、心配なの、本気で、絶対、メイちゃん、応援してね、絶対。
lines.en: Our dog's been going to the vet a lot lately. I've been worried about her, honestly.
lines.style: Tone shifts down and inward. Softer attack. The worry surfaces—not dramatic, but present. Slight hesitation, like she's checking whether it's okay to voice the concern.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、さようなら、と、お見送りする時、本気で、心、込めてるわよ、葵で、メイちゃん、絶対、感じてくれてる、本気で、嬉しい。
lines.en: When I say goodbye to customers, I really try to put my heart into it. I hope you feel that.
lines.style: Gentle and sincere, almost vulnerable. Slow, deliberate pacing. The kind of admission that costs a little to make. Trailing softly, like she's testing whether she's been understood.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 船のドック、行ったの、彼と、本気で、面白かったわよ、葵で、写真、見せたいわよね、絶対、メイちゃん、楽しみ、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: My boyfriend and I went to a shipyard last week—it was really interesting. I want to show you the photos.
lines.style: Brighter energy. Quickens slightly. Genuine enthusiasm that's not performed. The natural excitement of wanting to share something real with someone you like.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: アルプスの旅行、本気で、行ってみたいわよね、メイちゃん、葵で、いつか、一緒に、行こうね、絶対、本気で、夢、ね、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: I've been wanting to go to the Alps for so long. Maybe we could go together someday?
lines.style: Dreamy, a little wistful. Quieter delivery. Opens the invitation gently, like it's a wish she's been holding. Slight upward lilt at the end—hopeful but not demanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 相撲の土俵、本気で、彼、見たいって、言ってたの、葵、私たちも、行ってみない?絶対、本気で、楽しいよ、本気、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: My boyfriend said he really wants to see a sumo match. Should we go sometime too?
lines.style: Playful, drawing you in. Light, friendly tone. The 'should we' carries genuine wanting—not commanding, but inviting. Quick, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 囲碁、最近、本気で、ハマってるのよ、葵、メイちゃん、興味、ある?一緒に、対戦、してみない?本気で、絶対、楽しい、本当に。
lines.en: I've gotten really into Go lately. Are you interested in it? Want to play a match together?
lines.style: Eager and slightly conspiratorial. Quickens with genuine curiosity about whether she'll say yes. Open and inviting without pushing. The energy of finding a new hobby and wanting to share it.
